input.quote: This Agreement shall be automatically renewed for an additional one year period on each anniversary of the Effective Date, unless terminated by either Party hereto upon ninety (90) days written notice to the other.
input.rationale: Section 4.1 provides automatic successive one-year renewals but requires ninety (90) days' written notice to prevent renewal, which exceeds the fallback ceiling of a 60-day non-renewal notice window (and the preferred 30 days). The one-year renewal term is compliant, and no renewal price-uplift mechanic exists anywhere in the Agreement (fees are a fixed revenue share under Section 3.1), so the conditional price-cap element is not triggered. We therefore make the single shortest change to reach the fallback: 90 days becomes 60 days. We note only for the record that the preferred position would also add a 30-day opt-out and a 60-day Vendor reminder; those are noted, not insisted upon, at the fallback level.

mappings.element: If renewal is automatic, Customer's non-renewal notice window is no more than 60 days.
If renewal permits price increases, each increase is capped at 5 percent.
mappings.quote: This Agreement shall be automatically renewed for an additional one year period on each anniversary of the Effective Date

proposal.comment: [Playbook] We shortened the non-renewal notice window from ninety to sixty days so we can exit an automatic renewal within our playbook fallback window; the one-year renewal term and the absence of any renewal price uplift are already acceptable.
proposal.summary: Shorten the non-renewal notice window in Section 4.1 from 90 to 60 days.
